    Cookies

    This page lists what #trytpc stores in your browser, and why. There are no advertising cookies and no cross-site tracking.

    What is stored

    What is stored
    NamePurposeDuration
    trytpc_localeRemembers whether you chose Thai or English, so the language toggle keeps you on the same page in your chosen language and you are not asked again on your next visit.1 year
    trytpc_themeRemembers whether you chose the light or dark theme. If you choose System, this cookie is not set.1 year
    trytpc_jsTells the site your browser runs JavaScript, so pages with filters or a search open from the ready-made copy and load faster. It holds only the value 1.Until you close your browser
    lf_journey_…, cp_journey, br_journeyRemembers the lost and found, complaint or borrowing form you are filling in, so you can move between its pages. It holds only a random code. Your answers are kept encrypted on our server.2 hours
    lf_track, cp_track, br_trackRemembers your private tracking link after you open it, so you can see the progress of your case without the link staying in the address bar.1 hour

    Why there is no consent banner

    The cookies above are strictly necessary for the site's basic operation. Data protection law does not require consent for this category of cookie, so this site does not show a cookie consent banner.

    Analytics

    This site does not use analytics or tracking tools. It does not count visitors, does not create an identifier that tracks you across visits or across other sites, and never uses your usage data for advertising.

    Cookies and tracking not used

    No advertising cookies, no third-party marketing trackers, and your usage data is never sold or shared with anyone outside this service.

    Deleting cookies

    You can delete these cookies at any time in your browser settings. Nothing else on the site is affected. On your next visit the site picks a language from your browser's language setting and follows your system theme.

    Data kept on your device by What to eat

    The What to eat section keeps personal data only in your browser's own storage (localStorage), under names that start with trytpc.eat.v1. That is your favourites, dishes you never want suggested, what you tapped "I'll eat this" for with the price at that moment, your saved filters and a saved week plan. None of it is sent anywhere and there is no account. Clear it any time with the "Clear everything" button on Your stuff (/eat/mine), or by clearing this site's data in your browser.
